featured_reviews.name: Asawari Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I contacted Desi Bites when my family was going through a rough time due to covid and she was extremely accomdating and quickly agreed to send the tiffin on a short notice. The food comes in plates (plastic ones) sufficient for just one person. Priced decently, the taste was good. Since my parents are extremely used to Maharashtrain food they enjoyed the change but eventually found it to be the same. Rotis were slightly over fried but overall I would rate the service to be 5/5 otherwise. Anju is really sweet and accomdating.

You must try Desi Bites for some lovely & hot Desi food.

featured_reviews.name: Aagam Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a great experience at Navarang Veg. Restaurant in Bhayander West! Ordered the Manchow Soup, Paneer Chilli with Gravy, Paneer Sabji, and Kulcha. The soup and paneer dishes were delicious and flavorful. However, the kulcha had a bit too much butter for my taste. Overall, good food and decent prices. 👍👌 Would recommend with a slight adjustment to the butter in the kulcha. Looking forward to trying more dishes

featured_reviews.name: Tanisha shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Navrang Hotel, Mira Road!
Every dish we ordered was spot on !
The Cheese Pav Bhaji was rich and flavorful, the Chilli Cheese Toast had the perfect crunch, Veg Momos were soft and tasty, and the Classic Cheese Pizza was loaded and fresh.
DESERT TIME : The Mango Sunrise was especially refreshing — it’s rare to get fresh (in-house) mango pulp in off-season, and it tasted absolutely divine!

The food quality, portion size, and presentation were all excellent, and the service was quick and polite. You can truly taste the effort they put into every dish.
If you’re in and around Mira Road and want delicious vegetarian food with great variety — this place is a must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Patel
featured_reviews.review_text: Navarang Veg. Restaurant offers a decent variety of Punjabi and Chinese dishes at reasonable prices. It is a strictly average spot for a quick vegetarian meal, but there is definitely room for improvement in hygiene and ambiance.

The Surmai (Kingfish) Fry was out of this world — perfectly marinated in fresh coastal masala, fried to a beautiful golden crisp on the outside while staying juicy and tender inside. You can taste the freshness in every bite! 🐟

The Prawns dish was equally outstanding — plump, fresh prawns cooked with the perfect balance of spices. Absolutely finger-licking good! 🦐
